service.description: Stores the values a device sent: the read results of a request and the samples of its subscription or polling. Each sample has its own transaction, so one invalid sample does not lose the others. A value equal to the stored one (within the item tolerance) is not written unless the item allows duplicates. To act after a store, add a SECA on this service (the after-store callback of the former gateway).

parameter.name: requestName
parameter.description: The request the samples come from; its DeviceRequestItem records give allowDuplicate, tolerance and the bit width.

parameter.name: logging
parameter.description: true: ParameterLog rows, false: the current Parameter value.

parameter.name: samples
parameter.description: Maps with deviceId, parameterId (none: a DeviceLog row), value, sourceTime, receivedTime, quality and logValueKind (numeric, enumeration or message).

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: One map per sample, in order: parameterId, status (stored, unchanged or failed) and error.

service.description: Stores the events of a PLC log subscription (PlcLogServices): ParameterLog rows for the events of a Parameter, DeviceLog rows for the others. A separate service from store#Samples so a SECA can tell them apart.

service.description: Tells the user, with a Moqui notification on the topic DeviceGatewayInbound, that the samples of a subscription or polling request have failed to store for device_gateway_error_notification_seconds (inboundError), or store again after such a notice (inboundRecovered). Called by the persistence worker.

service-call.name: moqui.device.DeviceServices.send#DeviceNotification
service-call.in-map: {deviceId:deviceId, notificationTopic:'DeviceGatewayInbound', notificationType:(failing ? 'danger' : 'success'), notificationTitle:(failing ? 'Device data not stored' : 'Device data stored again') + ' (' + requestName + ')', message:failing ? ('The values of request ' + requestName + ' have not been stored for ' + (errorDurationSeconds || 0) + ' s: ' + (errorMessage || 'unknown error')) : ('The values of request ' + requestName + ' are stored again after ' + (errorDurationSeconds || 0) + ' s of errors.')}
